# Outpost

> A free daily briefing on cybersecurity, modern warfare technology, geodata and geopolitics, compiled from open sources. Every story links to the outlet that reported it.

## Sections
- [Top stories](https://www.outpostdaily.com/): the best of cyber, warfare tech and geopolitics today
- [Cyber](https://www.outpostdaily.com/cyber/): breaches, campaigns, advisories
- [Exploited vulnerabilities](https://www.outpostdaily.com/cves/): CISA KEV with CVSS scores
- [Warfare](https://www.outpostdaily.com/warfare/): drones, electronic warfare, missiles, defence systems
- [Geopolitics](https://www.outpostdaily.com/geopolitics/): strategy, geo wars, GNSS and satellite security
- [Today & Learn](https://www.outpostdaily.com/today/): top 5, checklist and concepts explained
- [OSINT Toolbox](https://www.outpostdaily.com/toolbox/): tools for verifying the news
- [Glossary](https://www.outpostdaily.com/glossary/): plain-language definitions
- [Archive](https://www.outpostdaily.com/archive/): all past editions

## Reference
- [About](https://www.outpostdaily.com/about/): who publishes it, disclosure and FAQ
- [Methodology](https://www.outpostdaily.com/methodology/): how the briefing is compiled, what the AI does and its limits
- [RSS feed](https://www.outpostdaily.com/feed.xml)
- [Source code](https://github.com/kyrillidis/outpostdaily): public pipeline and source list (MIT)
